notes: The layout maker now SHOWS the layout. Cards are drawn as the real runes, in the panel theme itself, with the live clock and your real weather -- so you decide what it looks like before you save it, not after.
You can set how tall the strip is, and the height is saved with the layout.
Layouts you save are now offered alongside the built-in ones when you pick a layout for a portal, in the order you arranged them, and they bring their runes with them.
